text:
OnCallBot: :rotating_light: Pager fired: latency-spike-prod-east-1 (p50/p95 p99 increasing). Auto-escalation to eng-oncall. See incident link: https://incidents.redwood.local/INC-2026-789

Alex: FYI taking handoff, I'm primary until 07:00 UTC. Brief: sustained p95 CPU on inference pods in eu-west-2 and increased request queueing in prod-east-1. Some customers reporting timeouts.

Maya: copying, I'm secondary. Any known deploys?

Alex: No deploys at spike start. We saw traffic shift to east-1 traffic lane and downstream k8s node churn. Key mitigation in progress: scale up ded. pool, enable model-fallback for noisy customers, and throttle noisy clients.

Diego: added note — routing fallback to secondary model variant (redwood/llm-v2-q4f) is already enabled for route /generate for tiered-customers. That reduced tail for a small sample.

Alex: Current active alerts:
- prod-east-1 inference latency p95 > 1200ms (alerting)
- queue_length > 5000 on inference-queue-prod-east (warning)
- pod_restart_rate > 3m on model-serving pods in eu-west-2 (warning)

Maya: Customer impact: we have 3 customers with timeouts > 5% request failure, others seeing degraded p95. No PagerDuty high-severity customer pages yet, but SRE Pager flagged degraded SLAs.

Alex: Mitigations applied so far:
1) Temporary autoscale bump for dedicated pool in prod-east-1 (x2 replicas).
2) Enabled prefix KV cache warmup for hot prefixes for top customers.
3) Applied token-level throttling policy to customer-id: cust-42 to reduce noisy retry storms.
4) Engaged routing fallback to model-variant: redwood/llm-v2-q4f for non-SLA traffic.

Commands run (for context):
```bash
# scale dedicated pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/dedicated-pool-east --replicas=8
# enable fallback via config api
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/configs/routes/fallback -d '{"route":"/generate","variant":"llm-v2-q4f","duration":600}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'
```

Diego: Observability notes — dashboards updated, added a log-sampling filter to capture correlated request ids. Query I used:
```
index=prod logs | where service=="inference" and region=="prod-east-1" | stats count() by request_id, status_code
```

Maya: Coverage notes for next shift: primary for 07:00–15:00 UTC is Maya, secondary is Diego. Gap: APAC prime hours 22:00–02:00 UTC have limited overlap; ask infra to keep an eye on capacity.

Alex: Known risk items still open:
- potential noisy client retries (we throttled one but may be others)
- unhealthy node autoscaler sometimes delays scale-up during sustained small bursts
- KV cache warmup may not cover cold tenants yet

Maya: Immediate next actions I will take during handoff:
- validate autoscaler actions succeeded (watch nodes + pods)
- check that fallback config persists and client routing is stable
- monitor customer error rates, escalate to SEs for impacted customers if >10%

Alex: Quick playbook pointer: runbook 'latency-spike' has the checklist + rollback steps: https://runbooks.redwood.local/latency-spike. If we need to do a hard read-only fallback, use the ReadOnly feature flag: ro-fallback=true in route config.

Maya: If you get pages overnight, use channel #inc-bridge to coordinate and ping me and Diego. Also temporary note: if p99 > 5s for >2m escalate to Infra oncall (tag infra-oncall).

Alex: Leaving some sticky todos for you:
- verify cache hit rate increases for top-5 tenants (dashboard link in casebook)
- keep the throttles on cust-42 until queue drains below 1000
- if nodes keep restarting, run the pod diagnostic script and collect /var/log/containerd for the team

Diego: adding commands for diagnostics:
```bash
# collect pod diagnostics
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-serving -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs <pod> --previous > /tmp/pod-previous.log
# node health
kubectl get nodes -o json | jq '.items[] | {name:.metadata.name, conditions:.status.conditions}'
```

SRE Pager: :white_check_mark: Added follow-up ticket INC-2026-789 in tracking, assigned to Alex (primary) until 07:00 UTC, then Maya.

Alex: ok handing off now — I'm available for questions for next 30m then offline. Good luck, team. :pray:

Maya: thanks — taking over. I'll post a short update every 20m or on any customer-impacting change. :thumbsup:

OnCallBot: thread closed for handoff summary (retain in channel).
